name: caroline-gerard-functions

scripts.partage: rm -rf src/partage && mkdir -p src/partage/lib && cp ../types.ts src/partage/types.ts && cp ../lib/factures-calcul.ts ../lib/factures-courriel.ts src/partage/lib/
